Done. Moved 12 files from `db.query` to `db.execute`: `couponService.js`, `cohort.js`, `returnService.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `refund.js`, `shipment.js`, and `session.js`.

One file still calls `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. I left it alone since its header says it's overwritten on every vendor upgrade, so local edits would just get lost.
